Anchored Glacier Stance.name: Anchored Glacier Stance
Anchored Glacier Stance.description: The user's signature move: they root into an anchored glacier stance of stone-hard ice that no charge, blast or truck can push over. Until the end of their next turn no blow harms them, and they slam both forearms down to drive a wave of stone-ice across a street for massive bludgeoning and cold damage; held back, it only pins feet. Pushing both natures leaves them unable to use the Quirk next turn. Strain: severe.
